text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Tuberculosis. The combination of systemic symptoms (fever, night sweats, weight loss), supraclavicular lymphadenopathy, and the new finding of mediastinal and cervical lymph node enlargement, alongside the clinical picture of a chronic cough, is highly characteristic of disseminated or miliary tuberculosis. The initial workup supports this, and the imaging findings confirm the diagnosis.
